name: Switch
summary: Toggle-controlled routing node with named outputs. Accepts any input type and routes data to enabled outputs while blocking disabled ones.

inputs.description: Single input handle accepting any data type (image, text, audio, video, 3d). Type is derived from connected upstream node.

outputs.description: Multiple named output handles. Each output has an enable/disable toggle. Data only flows to enabled outputs.

executionNotes: Switch maintains a switches array of {id, name, enabled} objects. Each switch represents an output handle. inputType is dynamically inferred from the connected input edge. When an output switch is disabled (enabled: false), data does not flow to that output even if it has downstream connections. Users toggle switches via UI buttons or checkboxes. No data transformation occurs; enabled outputs pass data through unchanged.

exampleConnections.scenario: Route generated video to multiple named outputs (e.g., 'hd', 'preview', 'archive'). Toggle which outputs receive the video.
Enable one switch output to feed video to stitching, disable others for selective processing.
Route LLM output to multiple named channels (e.g., 'log', 'display', 'api'). Toggle which channels are active.
